definitions.explanation: The central or innermost portion of a geographical area, city, object, or region. Often used of the downtown core of a city, the inner zone of a typhoon, or the central part of a body or structure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中心部|ちゅうしんぶ}。
examples.english: The downtown area of the city.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中心部|ちゅうしんぶ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上陸|じょうりく}→上陸：20591_jouriku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The center of the typhoon made landfall.

examples.japanese: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中心部|ちゅうしんぶ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: Rent is extremely high in the central areas of Tokyo.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中心部|ちゅうしんぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集中|しゅうちゅう}していた→集中する：21908_shuuchuusuru⟧。
examples.english: The earthquake damage was concentrated in the central part of the city.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧ ('center; middle') and the suffix ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ ('part; section'). The ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ suffix is productive and produces area/zone nouns such as ⟦{上部|じょうぶ}→上部：11377_joubu⟧ ('upper part'), ⟦{下部|かぶ}→下部：11378_kabu⟧ ('lower part'), and ⟦{内部|ないぶ}→内部：05583_naibu⟧ ('interior').

USAGE:
Refers to the central zone of something that has spatial extent — a city, a region, a storm system, an organ. Slightly more technical or formal than plain ⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧, which can mean 'center point' or 'focal person.' Often translated as 'downtown,' 'city center,' or simply 'center' depending on context.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中心部|ちゅうしんぶ}: downtown of the city
- {中心部|ちゅうしんぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{位置|いち}する→位置する：09891_ichisuru⟧: to be located in the center
- {中心部|ちゅうしんぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧: to pass through the central area
- ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中心部|ちゅうしんぶ}: the center of a typhoon
- ⟦{都心|としん}→都心：04072_toshin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中心部|ちゅうしんぶ}: the very heart of the city
- ⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中心部|ちゅうしんぶ}: the town center

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧: center; focus — abstract 'center'; can refer to a point or person
- ⟦{都心|としん}→都心：04072_toshin⟧: urban center; downtown (specifically of a metropolis like Tokyo)
- ⟦{中央|ちゅうおう}→中央：03475_chuuou⟧: central; middle — emphasizes axis or national center ({中央政府|ちゅうおうせいふ})
- ⟦{中部|ちゅうぶ}→中部：11367_chuubu⟧: central region (of Japan) — proper geographic division
- ⟦{内部|ないぶ}→内部：05583_naibu⟧: interior — inside, not necessarily central
